feeds.title: NOMA News
feeds.description: NOMA is committed to preserving, interpreting, and enriching its collections and renowned sculpture garden; offering innovative experiences for learning and interpretation; and uniting, inspiring, and engaging diverse communities and cultures. Read news articles, activities of NOMA, and more.

feeds.title: Camille Barnes Studio Blog
feeds.description: Camille is an imaginative portrait artist, illustrator, painter, and one who is driven by an incredible passion for self-expression through art. She shares her Contemporary Fine Art Studio Blog with information about art history, updates about projects, shows, portraits, & more.

feeds.title: Inside New Orleans » Art
feeds.description: We provide an insight into the colorful culture and art of New Orleans. For 5 years, Inside New Orleans has presented thoughtful and beautiful editorial that is not only personal and illuminating but also imaginative and far-reaching. We bring readers to your business through colorful advertising.

feeds.title: Adam K. Hall Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Adam K. Hall grew up in Raleigh, North Carolina, but now I call New Orleans home. The rich heritage of New Orleans and his personal life is something that drives his artwork. His artwork and event updates can be found on his blog.

feeds.title: Jan Gilbert Art News
feeds.description: Interdisciplinary artist, curator, and educator Jan Gilbert mines memory, loss, and transition. She pushes boundaries of all sorts by forging objects, installations, rituals, and networks. Her universally compelling works are simultaneously personal and collective, public and private, local and global. Explore her blog to see her art work.

feeds.title: Arthur Roger Gallery News
feeds.description: The Arthur Roger Gallery represents mid-career to established artists. We post art pieces online. Read the latest art news and event updates here.

feeds.title: Anastasia Pelias News
feeds.description: Anastasia Pelias was born in New Orleans, LA. Pelias' work has been featured in notable exhibitions. Her bodies of work include oil paintings on canvas, works on paper, sculpture, video, and multi-dimensional site-specific and site-responsive installations. She shares her work, life, news, and more on this blog.

feeds.title: Hal Wilke Art Blog
feeds.description: Hal Wilke Art is a place to share the art I love to create. He offers completed paintings in his online store. The owner of this blog is a father, a sailor, and a painter, who shares his artwork, sailing experience, fatherhood, and more.

feeds.title: Casey Langteau Art Gallery Blog
feeds.description: Casey Langteau Johnson has been painting her entire life. She strictly uses palette knives to obtain a thick, touchable texture. She is known for creating large statement pieces in pastels and neutrals. She shares her artwork with the world via her blog.
